name: Banner widgets
author: Brett
description: Every chip and badge on the console's banner in one plugin. One table lists them all (web/registry.ts); one settings screen (Settings → Plugins → Banner widgets) shows or hides each one, moves it, sets its side, size, shape and icon; banner-widgets.* actions do the same from the API, MCP, CLI and voice. Other plugins only hand over their numbers through the console's banner data service (axf.banner-data@1): project, build profile, Claude account, Following Amber, What's new ticker, agent voice, wake listener, builds progress, main build status, alerts bell and count, + Plan. This plugin builds each asset, places it and keeps every old setting key, so nobody's choices move. It also reads five status badges itself (formerly the Badges plugin, claude-badge): Claude (one tiny AI test on load, axf.llm@1), VPS (the Claude Code login), axHub (the framework's live check), AmberX (phone connected) and the usage meter (5-hour and weekly limits of every saved account); each with a label, an icon per state, side, order and a tap action. Everything but the Claude test is plain code and costs no tokens. Removing the plugin removes the widgets; the banner, badge, status, counter and action-button asset types stay in the framework.
